name: BSP_Matrix_GetMaximumBasisLengthSquared

FCOMI/JC selects between rows0/1, then FCOMIP/JC compares selected row to row2. Carry includes unordered; equality retains earlier row. Ignores last column and translation. Native max-row rule, not spectral norm. Typed implementation retains instruction and float-store order. Original ABI: ECX=16-float matrix; x87 ST0=float result reloaded from float storage; RET.
